hypothesis: A non-destructive structured intent channel can make pinned E5's late-stage semantic gains complementary to champion BM25, while a structured-only negation-safe query can avoid embedding rejected preference prose.

query_variants.raw_history: Exact raw-history E5 control from dense_retrieval_v1.
query_variants.raw_plus_active: Raw history retained verbatim, followed by labeled active positive structured values.
query_variants.negation_safe_structured: Only labeled active positive structured values, excluding negative/no-preference prose, with current raw message only as an empty-structure fallback.

sparse_control: Champion field-aware BM25 receives unchanged raw history for every variant.

retrieval_gate.selection: Choose the candidate with highest all-stage union Recall@200; ties prefer raw_plus_active, then negation_safe_structured.
all_required: best candidate all-stage union Recall@200 >= raw-history control + 0.005
best candidate has at least 3 more all-stage dense-only unique-session rescues at 200 than raw-history control
best candidate first-turn union Recall@200 >= raw-history control - 0.01
best candidate all-stage union Recall@200 delta is non-negative in at least 4 of 5 outer folds
best candidate warm p95 latency <= 500 ms
retrieval_gate.action_if_pass: Run only the selected query with the smallest justified sparse-head union complete-policy interaction and compare it with the frozen champion.
retrieval_gate.action_if_fail: Park query+dense interaction without end-to-end work.

promotion_rule: Promote only if the retrieval gate passes and the single authorized end-to-end interaction turns unique recall into stable Top-10 technical-score improvement.
